data.narrative:
Modular Genetics is an undisclosed-stage biotech company founded by Kevin Jarrell and Temple Smith that has raised $5.8M to date. The valuation universe for Biotech & Health comprises 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Two standard triangulation methods are inapplicable here. Peer-median anchoring cannot be deployed because the company's narrow peer set—same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies within Biotech & Health—yields fewer than three datapoints; the sector contains 7 same-sector peers overall, but none satisfy the narrow filters required for a defensible median. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not disclosed; while the public Biotech & Health universe trades at a 8.1x price-to-sales median across the three public tickers, this multiple is inapplicable without the target's revenue figure. Private companies in this sector rarely disclose revenue publicly.

The absence of usable quantitative methods indicates that a valuation of Modular Genetics cannot be triangulated from the available data. Any range would require either disclosure of the company's revenue or identification of at least three private comparables at the same stage and valuation tier. The primary uncertainty is the lack of financial disclosure typical of early-stage private biotech.
